project_decisions: A pilot claim creates a keyed immutable binding before context compilation so later binding removal, demotion, rebinding, generation drift, or fencing-token drift fails closed.
The claimed task-binding trigger permits only the first complete transition of all completion fields while keeping task identity, initiative, pilot flag, artifact set, and creation time immutable.
Completion remains one transaction: task and execution completion, assurance completion fields, audit records, and completion event either commit together or roll back together.

Keyed integrity anchors remain outside SQLite and validators reject protected-row tamper even after immutability triggers are dropped; initialization restores canonical triggers without signing preexisting unanchored rows.
Runtime enforcement covers context use, heartbeat, checkpoint, and completion; the kill switch remains dispatch-only.
Task context and dashboard projections omit protected artifact bodies, credentials, principal details, fencing tokens, audit details, and execution session references.
